[[File:Droidshockarm.png|thumb|right|[[T3-M4]] utilizing a droid shock arm]]
The '''electro-shock prod''', also known as an '''electroshock probe''', '''droid shock arm''', or '''electro probe''', was a small appendage that could be attached to a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The probe emitted a brief electrical discharge, sufficient to short out a single [[computer terminal]] or [[security lock]]. If the probe was used on organic beings, it would stun them.

The probe was a standard feature in [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]].<ref name="SWTRP">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

==History==
A shock arm was included on [[T3-M4]], a [[T3-series utility droid]], in the days of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Shock arms were also incorporated thousands of years later on many models of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]] were two astromechs known to have shock arms.

==Behind the scenes==
In the video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', only [[T3-M4]] is capable of equipping this item.
